items.title: What’s Moving Markets Today?
items.summary: Major stock indexes faced pressure on Tuesday with a fresh slate of geopolitical tensions weighing on investors. The Dow industrials are down about 1%. Meanwhile, quantum computing stocks are on the rise.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Dives, These Stocks Lose Key Level; Aerospace Play Up After Trump Attack (Live Coverage)
items.summary: The Dow Jones index falls on the stock market today as Amgen plummets. An aerospace play jumps after President Trump hit out at a rival.

items.title: How Novartis' Double-Stacked Failures Reverberated Through Biopharma
items.summary: Novartis and Ionis' high-profile Lp(a) flop on Friday reverberated through biotech stocks on Tuesday, leading to a widespread drop.

items.title: Amgen's Olpasiran May Still Show Heart-Risk Reduction Despite Novartis Miss, UBS Says
items.summary: Amgen's (AMGN) experimental heart drug olpasiran may still show a meaningful reduction in major card

items.title: Novartis Stock Tanks Following Third Major Pipeline Setback
items.summary: Following two trial misses and a third clinical setback, analysts fear Novartis may miss its 2030 growth targets without further acquisitions.

items.title: Amgen Falls 10% as Novartis Trial Failure Clouds a Cholesterol Drug Class; NVS Stock Drops 14%
items.summary: Novartis just handed the entire Lp(a) drug class a failing grade, and Amgen is taking the worst of the punishment despite releasing promising trial results of its own on the very same morning.

items.title: Amgen, Novartis, Qualcomn, Corning, Lumentum, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Stocks declined on Tuesday as oil prices rose, renewing investor worries about hotter inflation and bolstering the case for the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates.  Investor attention may turn to  Apple  on Wednesday when the company holds its iPhone launch event.  Artificial-intelligence stocks were advancing despite the market’s inflation worries.

items.title: AstraZeneca Falls Today Even as Imfinzi Wins a Landmark Survival Test
items.summary: The 563-patient study hit three efficacy endpoints, but investors still lack hazard ratios and regulatory timing.
